name: Dundalk CT Georgian 6 Person Electric Cabin Sauna with Changeroom
description: Dundalk CT Georgian 6 Person Wood-Burning Cabin Sauna with Changeroom Transform your backyard or cottage into a peaceful retreat with the Canadian Timber Georgian Cabin Sauna with Changeroom. This classic shed-style sauna is both timeless and inviting - easy on the eyes while delivering deep, satisfying heat for true relaxation and recovery. Thoughtfully handcrafted in Ontario from locally sourced Eastern White Cedar, the Georgian Sauna offers the perfect balance of warmth, comfort, and durability. Known for its lighter natural color and tight, refined knots, this cedar creates a clean, rustic appearance while providing excellent resistance to moisture and long-term wear. The gentle, natural aroma of cedar encourages you to slow down, relax, and fully unwind. Each sauna is built for lasting quality, featuring solid cedar cradles and durable Ontario-sourced metal shingles made from Hamilton steel. The simple yet functional design maximizes heat efficiency, creating a cozy, inviting atmosphere ideal for both quiet solo moments and meaningful time with family and friends. Comfortably seating up to six people, the Georgian Sauna is a perfect backyard getaway for you, your spouse, and your family. Choose the standard model or customize your sauna with an optional change room or porch to suit your space and lifestyle. Proudly built with local craftsmanship and materials, this sauna lets you relax while supporting Ontario-made quality - your own personal haven, right outside your door. Features 100% Canadian Made: Crafted in Canada using locally sourced premium cedar and expert Canadian craftsmanship. Solid Single Stave Wood Bevels: Built with premium Grade A solid cedar for exceptional strength and durability. Wood Resistant to Rot, Decay, and Insects: Naturally resistant cedar designed to withstand harsh outdoor environments. Metal Shingle Finished Roof: Premium 28-gauge steel roof provides long-lasting, maintenance-free weather protection. Environmentally Friendly: Responsibly sourced cedar from certified sustainable Canadian lumber mills. Easy Assembly: Designed for straightforward installation with step-by-step videos and assembly guides. Easy Maintenance: Premium cedar construction makes cleaning and long-term upkeep simple. Watch the Dundalk Georgian with Changeroom Product Overview Video Specifications Sauna Size Georgian with Changeroom Comfortably Seats 6 People Exterior Depth 146.75" (247 cm) Exterior Width 97.25" (373 cm) Exterior Height 100.75" (256 cm) Interior Depth 132.5" (213 cm) Interior Width 85" (336 cm) Interior Height 86.25" (219 cm) Interior Volume 343 ft³ (9.7 m³) Electric Heater Available Yes Recommended Electric Heater Size 7.5 kW - 9 kW Technical Dundalk Georgian Assembly Instructions Watch the Georgian Cabin Sauna with Changeroom Assembly Video Dundalk Georgian Specifications Sheet Product Drawing Imperial Product Drawing Metric Regular sauna maintenance is an important aspect of owning a sauna and is essential for preserving the longevity of the sauna and ensuring a pleasant and relaxing experience. General Guidelines Use towels on benches to protect the wood and absorb sweat during sauna use. Depending on local humidity and weather conditions, the cedar may shrink or expand as it absorbs moisture. The goal is for the cedar to expand into the stainless-steel bands, tightening the sauna staves. It is recommended to tighten the bands after the initial installation which is typically within the first month, and then check them periodically to ensure they remain secure. Use a ¾” wrench to tighten as needed. Ensure that both the air inlet and outlet vents are unobstructed to maintain proper airflow. The exterior of your sauna can be stained using any product recommended by your local retailer. LeisureCraft recommends and stocks Livos stain products for this purpose. The interior is typically left natural and unfinished, but if you wish to enhance and protect the wood, Meldos Sauna Oil by Livos, also available from Leisurecraft this can be applied to bring out the cedar’s natural color and grain. After Each use: Ventilate the sauna: Open the door after each session to allow fresh air circulation and reduce moisture buildup. Wipe surfaces: Use a clean, dry towel to remove sweat and moisture from benches, backrests, and all wooden surfaces. Rinse with cold water: This helps close the pores of the wood and promotes faster drying. In the event of a valid warranty claim, LeisureCraft will provide replacement parts at no charge. However, the replacement of parts will not extend the original warranty period. This warranty is limited solely to the replacement of parts and does not cover any associated service, labor, or installation costs.
